tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search cancer support resources in Washington State. Filter by category (housing, food, mental-health, financial, legal, care, transport, children, rights, programs, education), county, tier, or free-text query. Returns matching resources with name, description, phone, URL, eligibility, and cost.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Get full details for a single cancer support resource by ID, including locations, hours, and match criteria.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all 11 support categories with names, descriptions, and resource counts. Use this to understand what types of resources are available before searching.

tools.name: list_counties
tools.description: List all 39 Washington State counties. Use this to find the correct county name for filtering search results.
